pattern_table.Part / Subject: Part-1: Chhattisgarh General Knowledge (10 marks), General Hindi (10 marks), General English (10 marks), General Mathematics & Logical Reasoning (10 marks)

exam_pattern.details: The written examination carries a total of 120 marks for a duration of 2 hours, comprising objective-type multiple-choice questions without negative marking. | Qualifying marks in the written exam: Minimum 30% marks to be eligible for the merit list based on which 10 candidates per 1 post are invited for the skill/practical test.

syllabus.details: Chhattisgarh General Knowledge: History, freedom movement, geography, climate, physical conditions, census, archaeological and tourist spots, tribes, art, culture, economy, forests, agriculture, administrative structure, local governance, industry, energy, water, mineral resources, and current affairs. General Hindi: Vowels, consonants, spelling, gender, number, tense, noun, pronoun, adjective, verbs, compound structure, sandhi, grammatical errors, word types (tatsam, tadbhav, deshaj, videshi), synonyms, antonyms, multi-meaning words, one-word substitution, idioms, and proverbs. General English: Number, gender, articles, pronoun, adjectives, verb, conjunctions, prepositions, active/passive voice, direct/indirect narration, synonyms, antonyms, one-word substitution, spellings. General Mathematics & Logical Reasoning: Reasoning, relationship analysis, analogy, numerical ability, odd-one-out, numerical series, letter series, coding-decoding, visual reasoning, mathematical operations, patterns. General Science (Chemistry, Physics, Biology) & Computer Knowledge: Chemical reactions, periodic table, metals, non-metals, metallurgy, organic compounds, polymers, soap, detergents; light, reflection, mirrors, electricity, Ohm's law, resistance, electrical energy, solar cells, PN junction, diodes; plant/animal transport, blood, heart, photosynthesis, respiration, digestion, nervous system, brain, reproduction, heredity, DNA; computers, CPU, input/output devices, printers, operating systems, MS Office, internet, antivirus, multimedia, CDs/DVDs, search engines, AI.

how_to_apply: Visit the official website at www.smkvbastar.ac.in.
Navigate to Career > Recruitment Portal > Applicant Login > New Registration and complete the online registration.
Log in using the received user ID and password sent to your registered mobile number.
Go to My Applications, select Advertisement Number, select Non-Teaching Post, and click Apply for Selected Post.
Fill in personal information accurately and click Save & Continue.
Enter educational qualifications under Educational Qualifications and add details.
Upload required documents such as caste certificate, domicile certificate, educational certificates, and experience certificates under Document Details.
Upload recent passport-size color photo and signature (file size between 30 KB to 100 KB).
Select examination center preferences from the available districts.
Preview all entered details, make corrections if any, and proceed to payment to pay the application fee via Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI.
Download and print a hard copy of the final submitted online application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is SMKV Bastar Laboratory Attendant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive conducted by Shaheed Mahendra Karma Vishwavidyalaya, Bastar for 24 fourth-grade Laboratory Attendant vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Laboratory Attendant post?
faq.answer: A total of 24 vacancies are available for the Laboratory Attendant post across various categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 4 November 2026 up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 12th class examination from a recognized board or institution with Chemistry as a compulsory subject.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years as of 01-01-2026, and the maximum age limit inclusive of all relaxations is 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for general and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 for unreserved and OBC (non-creamy layer) candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for SMKV Bastar Laboratory Attendant Recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the recruitment portal at www.smkvbastar.ac.in by registering, filling out personal and qualification details, uploading documents, and paying the fee.

faq.question: Q8. Is there negative marking in the written examination?
faq.answer: No, there is no negative marking in the written examination.

faq.question: Q9. What is the pay scale for the Laboratory Attendant post?
faq.answer: The post carries a pay scale of Rs. 5,200 - 20,200 with Grade Pay Rs. 1,800 under Pay Matrix Level-03.

faq.question: Q10. When will the written examination be conducted?
faq.answer: The examination date has not been announced yet in the notification and will be published on the university website.
